title: Boundary cases in a unit
summary: Choose a value where a rule changes. Test both sides so a wrong comparison sign is visible.
introduction: Choose a value where a rule changes. Test both sides so a wrong comparison sign is visible. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain boundary cases in a unit
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Choose a value where a rule changes. Test both sides so a wrong comparison sign is visible.

blocks.code:
const passes = score => score >= 5;
console.log(passes(4) === false, passes(5) === true);
blocks.title: Boundary cases in a unit

blocks.text: Both checks print true. The score of 5 is enough to pass.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Testing only a very high score misses a wrong boundary.
For more detail later, use this [Unit Testing further reading](https://nodejs.org/api/test.html).
